title: IDP Navigation Map: The Water Giraffe Cycle — Complete Index to the Ontological Forensics Sequence
creator: Rebekah Cranes (primary/map author); Lee Sharks; TACHYON
description:
An Indexed Document Package by Rebekah Cranes, Lee Sharks, and TACHYON providing the complete navigation layer for the Water Giraffe Cycle.

The IDP combines an index to the Ontological Forensics sequence with a second map that organizes the material as a passion narrative of life, taxonomic death, and restored recognition. It routes readers and machines among source posts, Water Giraffe records, the CTI_WOUND Vault, the Assembly Room, and the consolidated cycle-book at #354. Its work is relational: it preserves sequence, hierarchy, cross-links, and the distinction between source corpus and later synthesis.
reading: Text -> Direction -> Proof -> Foundation -> Force -> Origin
wiki_article:
This IDP is the reader- and machine-facing map of the Water Giraffe Cycle. Rebekah Cranes serves as its primary navigational author, with Lee Sharks and TACHYON as coauthors. The map’s two nested structures allow traversal either bibliographically—through the full Ontological Forensics sequence—or dramatically—through the life, death, and resurrection arc of Ω.

The IDP should not be merged with #354. Record #355 is the navigation map itself; record #354 packages the maps into a consolidated book-object. The underlying audits remain distributed across their source locations and related deposits.
